# Pesher Habakkuk Column 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QpHab (Cave 1), Col. 3 | **Condition:** Well preserved with minor edge damage

---

**3:1** "[...who] march through-the-breadth-of the-earth

**3:2** to-take-possession-of dwellings not-their-own" (Hab 1:6b).

**3:3** Its pesher concerns the-Kittim, who [...]

**3:4** advance across-the-plain to-smite and-to-plunder

**3:5** the-cities-of the-earth.

**3:6** For this is what-it-says: "to-take-possession-of dwellings not-their-own."

**3:7** "Dread and-terrible is-he;

**3:8** from-himself his-justice and-his-grandeur go-forth" (Hab 1:7).

**3:9** Its pesher concerns the-Kittim, the-fear

**3:10** and-the-dread of-whom are upon all the-nations.

**3:11** And-by-intention all their-planning is to-do evil,

**3:12** and-with cunning and-deceit they-deal with-all the-peoples.

**3:13** "Swifter than-leopards are-his-horses and-fiercer

**3:14** than-evening-wolves. His-horsemen spread-out and-his-horsemen

**3:15** come from-afar; they-fly like-an-eagle swooping-down to-devour.

**3:16** All-of-them come for-violence;

**3:17** the-set-of their-faces is-eastward" (Hab 1:8-9a).

---
*EMET notes: Column 3 covers Hab 1:6-10. The pesher format alternates between quotations of Habakkuk and their sectarian interpretations (pesharim). Hyphenated forms reflect Hebrew construct chains and bound morphemes. Technical sectarian terms preserved: Teacher of Righteousness (Moreh ha-Tsedeq), Wicked Priest (ha-Kohen ha-Rasha'), Man of the Lie (Ish ha-Kazav), Kittim (identified with Romans), Spouter of the Lie (Mattif ha-Kazav). Lacunae marked with [...] represent genuine manuscript damage.*
